title: Polynomial bound on testing length
statement: Let $c$ be a finite algebraic circuit with $n$ input variables, encoded as a binary word of length $L$, and let $m$ be a natural number. Then $n(m+4)+16(m+12)^2\le 2400(L+1)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a finite algebraic circuit with a natural number of input variables
